{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# First, confirm no non-numeric values except the expected '999999.99' for QA
print("Unique revenue values:")
print(data['revenue'].unique())

# Strip commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders
# Population: completed orders only
filtered_data = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Check final population
print(f"Final number of completed, non-QA orders: {len(filtered_data)}")

# Now check the channel and customer_segment balance
print("Channel distribution:")
print(filtered_data['channel'].value_counts())

print("Customer segment distribution by channel:")
print(filtered_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size())"}
